title: Learning Transferable Visual Models from Natural Language Supervision (CLIP)
description: Image-text contrastive pre-training on 400M web pairs. Zero-shot image classification. CLIP representations are the most transferable in vision. Foundation for DALL-E 2, LLaVA, and most multimodal models.
authors: Radford, Kim, Hallacy, Ramesh, Goh, Agarwal, Sastry, Askell, Mishkin, Clark, Krueger, Sutskever
